scope: @keld/electron app cells for the first-proof app surface on macOS at Electron 44.4.5 (ready, whenReady/isReady, session facts, single-instance verdict); not median-app product compatibility

doc_citation.quote: Emitted once, when Electron has finished initializing.

cells.test_name: app.ready.emitted-once: a ready listener does not run before host Ready, then runs exactly once, also when host Ready is delivered again
cells.negative_control: Emitting ready before host Ready, or emitting it again when the link delivers host Ready a second time, makes the mapped case fail.

doc_citation.quote:
Returns `Promise<void>` - fulfilled when Electron is initialized.
May be used as a convenient alternative to checking `app.isReady()`
and subscribing to the `ready` event if the app is not ready yet.

cells.test_name: app.when-ready.is-ready-agreement: whenReady stays pending while isReady is false and is fulfilled once isReady is true; after the event it is still fulfilled while a ready listener added then is not called
cells.negative_control: Replacing whenReady with Promise.resolve() makes the mapped case fail before host Ready, because it is fulfilled while isReady() is false; replaying ready to a listener added after the event also fails it.

doc_citation.quote:
`userData` The directory for storing your app's configuration files, which
    by default is the `appData` directory appended with your app's name.

cells.test_name: app.get-path.user-data-default today: the facade has no getPath, so app.getPath('userData') throws a TypeError
cells.negative_control: Today: adding app.getPath to the facade without inverting this case fails it. After GH-452 inverts it: a getPath('userData') that reads HOME or differs from the host-minted appData plus app name fails it.

doc_citation.quote: Returns `string` - The version of the loaded application.

cells.test_name: app.get-version.loaded-app today: the facade has no getVersion, so app.getVersion() throws a TypeError
cells.negative_control: Today: adding app.getVersion to the facade without inverting this case fails it. After GH-452 inverts it: a getVersion() that awaits the link or differs from the declared app version fails it.

doc_citation.quote:
Returns `string` - The current application's name, which is the name in the application's
`package.json` file.

cells.test_name: app.get-name.package-name today: the facade has no getName, so app.getName() throws a TypeError
cells.negative_control: Today: adding app.getName to the facade without inverting this case fails it. After GH-452 inverts it: for an app with no productName declared, a getName() that differs from the declared app name fails it.

doc_citation.quote: A `string` property that indicates the current application's name, which is the name in the application's `package.json` file.

cells.test_name: app.name.property today: the facade has no name property, so app.name is undefined
cells.negative_control: Today: adding a name property to the facade without inverting this case fails it. After GH-452 inverts it: for an app with no productName declared, an app.name that differs from the declared app name or from app.getName() fails it.

cells.test_name: app.get-app-path.app-directory today: the facade has no getAppPath, so app.getAppPath() throws a TypeError
cells.negative_control: Today: adding app.getAppPath to the facade without inverting this case fails it. After GH-452 inverts it: a getAppPath() that differs from the host-minted application directory fails it.

doc_citation.quote: Returns `string` - The current application locale, fetched using Chromium's `l10n_util` library.

cells.test_name: app.get-locale.after-ready today: the facade has no getLocale, so app.getLocale() throws a TypeError after ready
cells.negative_control: Today: adding app.getLocale to the facade without inverting this case fails it. After GH-452 inverts it: a getLocale() that throws or returns an empty string after the ready event fails it.

doc_citation.quote: A `boolean` property that returns  `true` if the app is packaged, `false` otherwise.

cells.test_name: app.is-packaged.dev-false today: the facade has no isPackaged, so app.isPackaged is undefined, not false
cells.negative_control: Today: adding an isPackaged property to the facade without inverting this case fails it. After GH-452 inverts it: hard-coding isPackaged to true fails it under keld dev.

doc_citation.quote:
The return value of this method indicates whether or not this instance of your
application successfully obtained the lock.

cells.test_name: app.request-single-instance-lock.primary-verdict today: the facade has no requestSingleInstanceLock, so the call throws a TypeError
cells.negative_control: Today: adding app.requestSingleInstanceLock to the facade without inverting this case fails it. After GH-453 inverts it: returning a constant true fails it for the second instance of the same declared app.

doc_citation.quote:
This method returns whether or not this instance of your app is currently
holding the single instance lock.

cells.test_name: app.has-single-instance-lock.holder today: the facade has no hasSingleInstanceLock, so the call throws a TypeError
cells.negative_control: Today: adding app.hasSingleInstanceLock to the facade without inverting this case fails it. After GH-453 inverts it: an answer that disagrees with this instance's requestSingleInstanceLock() verdict fails it.
